context:
Goal: a held card reads clearly, with one word for one thing.
Problem (goal): the one-word option on the held-words question does not say which word goes where; on the whole frame the chip, the offer and the Post button also say held, and each needs a new string, so only your word fixes the size of the change.
Based on (read): the designer's picture on the held-words question draws the line and the box only, and notes the other three places still say held.
Departs from: main shows held on the line, the chip, the offer and Post — this adds a rule for how far a one-word change reaches.
Waiting on: your answer on the held-words question. This matters only if you pick one word only there.
